scope: CENSUS — every Tier-2 abstract-only finding with a quote (not a sample)

by_half.note: Identical. No drift between extraction waves.

negative_control.method: 388 full-text quotes paired with the WRONG paper
negative_control.conclusion: The matcher discriminates; the 99% figures are not an artifact of a permissive test.

supersedes: All earlier Tier-2 abstract-only quote figures (89.3/94.2, then 96.6/98.9 on a 3,946-row sample).
remaining_uncertainty: Adjudication of the 127 residuals is LLM-based, not human-verified.
The retrieved-fulltext stratum (56,168 findings) is still sampled at 24 of 3,226 papers (0.7%); a census would require re-fetching every OA paper.
This measures quote PROVENANCE only. Whether findings correctly INTERPRET their quotes is the fidelity audit's question and remains unanswered.
